#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 对目标库运行 Flyway 迁移：./migrate.sh <dbname>
# 实现：flyway-maven-plugin（版本 = Spring Boot BOM 的 ${flyway.version}，在 web-java/pom.xml 锁定），
# 与应用内 Flyway 完全同版本 → 唯一迁移入口，Python 永不迁移。
# 连接信息 env 可覆盖：MVP_A_PG_HOST_PORT(55432) / MVP_A_PG_USER(postgres) / MVP_A_PG_PASSWORD(mvp_a_local)。
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
DB="${1:?usage: migrate.sh <dbname>}"
[[ "$DB" =~ ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$ ]] || { echo "invalid db name: $DB" >&2; exit 1; }

# 迁移前确保目标库存在（幂等）
"$SCRIPT_DIR/createdb.sh" "$DB" >/dev/null

POM="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../web-java" && pwd)/pom.xml"
PORT="${MVP_A_PG_HOST_PORT:-55432}"
USER="${MVP_A_PG_USER:-postgres}"
PASSWORD="${MVP_A_PG_PASSWORD:-mvp_a_local}"

# flyway-maven-plugin 已在 web-java/pom.xml 以 ${flyway.version}（= Boot BOM，当前 11.7.2）声明，
# `flyway:migrate` 前缀由该 POM 解析，无需在命令行重复版本号。
exec mvn -B -q -f "$POM" flyway:migrate \
  -Dflyway.url="jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/${DB}" \
  -Dflyway.user="$USER" \
  -Dflyway.password="$PASSWORD"

145: def _bounded_views(views: Any) -> list[str]:
146:     if not isinstance(views, (list, tuple)):
147:         return list(REQUIRED_VIEWS_ALL)
148:     ordered = [v for v in REQUIRED_VIEWS_ALL if v in set(views)]

161:     def _get_validator(self):
162:         if self._validator is None:
163:             with self._lock:
164:                 if self._validator is None:
165:                     self._validator = load_payload_validator(_PAYLOAD_SCHEMA)
166:         return self._validator

173:     def handle(self, ctx: HandlerContext, job: JobRow) -> Optional[HandlerResult]:
174:         assessment_id = str(job.payload["assessment_id"])
175:         rev = int(job.payload["processing_revision"])
176:         dcfg = dconfig_for(ctx)
177: 
178:         row = _load_assessment(ctx.engine, assessment_id)
179:         if row is None:
180:             raise JobFailed("ASSESSMENT_NOT_FOUND", "assessment row missing", retryable=False)
181:         if int(row["processing_revision"]) != rev:
182:             # 旧输入代次：合法作废，无写回，任务成功。
183:             mlog(log, logging.INFO, "analyze.stale_input", **job.log_fields())
184:             return None
185: 
186:         current_photo_version = int(row["current_photo_version"])
187:         media_ids = _images_for_version(row["photo_versions"], current_photo_version)
188:         if media_ids is None:
189:             self._transient_or_terminal(
190:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
191:                 code="SOURCE_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE",
192:                 message="current photo version images unavailable",
193:                 reason="photo_versions has no entry for current_photo_version",
194:             )
195:             return None  # pragma: no cover - helper always raises
196: 
197:         images = load_image_bytes(ctx.engine, storage_for(ctx), media_ids)
198:         if isinstance(images, str):
199:             self._transient_or_terminal(
200:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
201:                 code="SOURCE_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE",
202:                 message="source image object unavailable",
203:                 reason=images,
204:             )
205:             return None  # pragma: no cover
206: 
207:         face = face_port_for(ctx)
208:         skin = skin_port_for(ctx)
209:         storage = storage_for(ctx)
210: 
211:         # 2) 标记 analyzing（自有短事务；0 行 = 并发变更 → 合法作废）
212:         if not _mark_analyzing(ctx.engine, assessment_id, rev):
213:             mlog(log, logging.INFO, "analyze.mark_analyzing_noop", **job.log_fields())
214:             return None
215: 
216:         # 3) 质量 + 同人
217:         if ctx.abort_event.is_set():
218:             return None
219:         try:
220:             quality = face.quality(images)
221:         except ProviderUnavailable:
222:             self._transient_or_terminal(
223:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
224:                 code="DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE", message="face quality unavailable",
225:                 reason="quality provider unavailable",
226:             )
227:             return None  # pragma: no cover
228:         if getattr(quality, "status", "accepted") != "accepted":
229:             views = _bounded_views(getattr(quality, "required_views", ()))
230:             return self._retake_result(
231:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
232:                 classification="quality_rejected", code="QUALITY_REJECTED",
233:                 required_views=views, detail="quality check rejected current views",
234:             )
235:         if ctx.abort_event.is_set():
236:             return None
237:         try:
238:             same = face.same_person(images)
239:         except ProviderUnavailable:
240:             self._transient_or_terminal(
241:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
242:                 code="DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE", message="same-person check unavailable",
243:                 reason="same_person provider unavailable",
244:             )
245:             return None  # pragma: no cover
246:         if not getattr(same, "ok", False):
247:             return self._retake_result(
248:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
249:                 classification="not_same_person", code="NOT_SAME_PERSON",
250:                 required_views=list(REQUIRED_VIEWS_ALL),
251:                 detail="three views are not the same person",
252:             )
253: 
254:         # 4) 测肤分析 + 白名单校验
255:         if ctx.abort_event.is_set():
256:             return None
257:         try:
258:             analysis = skin.analyze(images)
259:             metrics = _validate_metrics(dcfg, analysis.metrics)
260:         except _ContractViolation as exc:
261:             self._terminal(
262:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
263:                 code="PROVIDER_CONTRACT_VIOLATION",
264:                 message="skin provider contract violation",
265:                 reason=str(exc)[:200],
266:             )
267:             return None  # pragma: no cover
268:         except JobFailed:
269:             raise
270:         except Exception as exc:
271:             self._transient_or_terminal(
272:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
273:                 code="DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE",
274:                 message="skin provider unavailable",
275:                 reason=type(exc).__name__,
276:             )
277:             return None  # pragma: no cover
278: 
279:         # 5) 结果图归档（发布前完成；幂等复用 provider_ref）
280:         if ctx.abort_event.is_set():
281:             return None
282:         try:
283:             archived = archive_result_images(
284:                 ctx.engine, storage,
285:                 environment=ctx.config.environment,
286:                 assessment_id=assessment_id,
287:                 photo_version=current_photo_version,
288:                 result_images=getattr(analysis, "result_images", []) or [],
289:                 max_bytes=dcfg.result_image_max_bytes,
290:             )
291:         except ArchiveError as exc:
292:             if exc.terminal:
293:                 self._terminal(
294:                     ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
295:                     code=exc.code, message="result image archive failed",
296:                     reason=exc.message,
297:                 )
298:             else:
299:                 self._transient_or_terminal(
300:                     ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
301:                     code=exc.code, message="result image archive failed",
302:                     reason=exc.message,
303:                 )
304:             return None  # pragma: no cover
305: 
306:         # 6) 身份 1:N 检索
307:         if ctx.abort_event.is_set():
308:             return None
309:         try:
310:             search = face.search_1n(dcfg.identity_namespace, images)
311:         except ProviderUnavailable:
312:             self._transient_or_terminal(
313:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
314:                 code="DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE", message="face search unavailable",
315:                 reason="search provider unavailable",
316:             )
317:             return None  # pragma: no cover
318:         classification = getattr(search, "classification", "ambiguous")
319: 
320:         if classification == "dependency_failed":
321:             self._transient_or_terminal(
322:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
323:                 code="DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE", message="face search unavailable",
324:                 reason="search dependency_failed",
325:             )
326:             return None  # pragma: no cover
327: 
328:         if classification in ("uncertain", "ambiguous"):
329:             return self._retake_result(
330:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
331:                 classification="uncertain", code="IDENTITY_UNCERTAIN",
332:                 required_views=list(REQUIRED_VIEWS_ALL),
333:                 detail="identity result uncertain; re-capture required",
334:             )
335: 
336:         if classification == "reliable_new":
337:             # 先对账 PG：本候选的登记此前是否已成功。登记协调横跨独立 job/进程，
338:             # 供应商替身/索引的可见性状态不保证跨调用保留；且 PG 成员行是权威事实。
339:             # 已存在成员 → 直接发布（重试不重复建正式成员），不再入队第二次登记。
340:             candidate_id = candidate_entity_id(dcfg.identity_namespace, assessment_id)
341:             reconciled_member_id = _find_member(
342:                 ctx.engine, dcfg.identity_namespace, candidate_id
343:             )
344:             if reconciled_member_id is None:
345:                 return self._handle_reliable_new(
346:                     ctx, job, dcfg, assessment_id, rev, current_photo_version, media_ids
347:                 )
348:             member_id = reconciled_member_id
349:             identity_result = {
350:                 "schema_version": 1,
351:                 "classification": "reliable_new",
352:                 "quality": {"status": "accepted", "required_views": []},
353:                 "phase": "enrolled_reconciled",
354:                 "candidate_entity_id": candidate_id,
355:                 "member_id": member_id,
356:             }
357:         elif classification == "matched":
358:             # MATCHED → 解析成员（provider 可见性延迟 → 可重试至预算）
359:             face_subject_ref = getattr(search, "face_subject_ref", None)
360:             member_id = _find_member(ctx.engine, dcfg.identity_namespace, face_subject_ref)
361:             if member_id is None:
362:                 self._transient_or_terminal(
363:                     ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
364:                     code="MEMBER_NOT_VISIBLE", message="matched member not yet visible",
365:                     reason="member row missing for matched face_subject_ref",
366:                 )
367:                 return None  # pragma: no cover
368:             identity_result = {
369:                 "schema_version": 1,
370:                 "classification": "matched",
371:                 "quality": {"status": "accepted", "required_views": []},
372:                 "member_id": member_id,
373:             }
374:         else:
375:             self._transient_or_terminal(
376:                 ctx, job, assessment_id, rev,
377:                 code="DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE", message="unexpected identity classification",
378:                 reason="unexpected classification",
379:             )
380:             return None  # pragma: no cover
381: 
382:         # 7) 发布
383:         report_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
384:         report_summary = {
385:             "schema_version": 1,
386:             "conclusion": analysis.conclusion,
387:             "headline_metrics": [m["name"] for m in metrics][:8],
388:         }
389:         report_payload = {
390:             "schema_version": 1,
391:             "conclusion": analysis.conclusion,
392:             "metrics": metrics,
393:             "description": analysis.description,
394:             "images": [
395:                 {"media_id": img["media_id"], "caption": img["caption"]} for img in archived
396:             ],
397:             "model_info": {
398:                 "skin_provider": getattr(skin, "provider_name", "unknown"),
399:                 "model_version": getattr(analysis, "model_version", "unknown"),
400:             },
401:         }
402:         return HandlerResult(
403:             business_tx=lambda conn: _publish(
404:                 conn,
405:                 assessment_id=assessment_id,
406:                 rev=rev,
407:                 member_id=member_id,
408:                 report_id=report_id,
409:                 report_summary=report_summary,
410:                 report_payload=report_payload,
411:                 identity_result=identity_result,
412:                 max_attempts=ctx.config.retry_max_attempts,
413:             )
414:         )

418:     def _handle_reliable_new(
419:         self,
420:         ctx: HandlerContext,
421:         job: JobRow,
422:         dcfg: DConfig,
423:         assessment_id: str,
424:         rev: int,
425:         current_photo_version: int,
426:         media_ids: dict[str, str],
427:     ) -> Optional[HandlerResult]:
428:         ns = dcfg.identity_namespace
429:         candidate_id = candidate_entity_id(ns, assessment_id)
430:         correlation_id = enroll_correlation_id(ns, assessment_id)
431: 
432:         # 先持久化阶段（自有短事务、代次守卫），再做跨事务入队
433:         identity_result = {
434:             "schema_version": 1,
435:             "classification": "reliable_new",
436:             "candidate_entity_id": candidate_id,
437:             "phase": "enroll_pending",
438:             "correlation_id": correlation_id,
439:         }
440:         if not _persist_enroll_pending(ctx.engine, assessment_id, rev, identity_result):
441:             mlog(log, logging.INFO, "analyze.enroll_persist_noop", **job.log_fields())
442:             return None
443: 
444:         payload = {
445:             "schema_version": 1,
446:             "correlation_id": correlation_id,
447:             "assessment_id": assessment_id,
448:             "photo_version": str(current_photo_version),
449:             "processing_revision": str(rev),
450:             "images": {
451:                 "front": media_ids["front"],
452:                 "left": media_ids["left"],
453:                 "right": media_ids["right"],
454:             },
455:             "provider_config_revision": dcfg.provider_config_revision,
456:         }
457:         try:
458:             enqueue_identity_enroll(
459:                 ctx.engine,
460:                 job_type="identity.enroll",
461:                 dedup_key=f"identity:{ns}:{candidate_id}",
462:                 owner_type="identity_namespace",
463:                 owner_id=namespace_owner_id(ns),
464:                 input_revision=rev,
465:                 payload=payload,
466:                 max_attempts=ctx.config.retry_max_attempts,
467:             )
468:         except EnrollSlotOccupied:
469:             # namespace 未决登记占满：本候选等待重搜（绝不并行登记第二份）
470:             pass
471: 
472:         # 无论新入队/重放/槽占用，本次分析都不能发布：等待登记完成后重搜命中。
473:         if job.attempt_count >= job.max_attempts:
474:             # 预算耗尽：登记协调项仍在（槽位保持占用），本任务落 failed 终态。
475:             _mark_failed(
476:                 ctx.engine, assessment_id, rev, "IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_TIMEOUT",
477:                 "enrollment did not complete within attempt budget",
478:             )
479:             raise JobFailed(
480:                 "IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_TIMEOUT",
481:                 "reliable new candidate enrollment timed out",
482:                 retryable=False,
483:             )
484:         raise JobFailed(
485:             "IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_PENDING",
486:             "reliable new candidate awaiting enrollment",
487:             retryable=True,
488:         )

490:     def _retake_result(
491:         self,
492:         ctx: HandlerContext,
493:         job: JobRow,
494:         assessment_id: str,
495:         rev: int,
496:         *,
497:         classification: str,
498:         code: str,
499:         required_views: list[str],
500:         detail: str,
501:     ) -> HandlerResult:
502:         views = _bounded_views(required_views)
503:         identity_result = {
504:             "schema_version": 1,
505:             "classification": classification,
506:             "quality": {"status": "needs_retake", "required_views": views},
507:             "detail": detail[:200],
508:         }
509:         # failure_detail 仅内部诊断（裁定 3）：required_views 唯一权威通道 = identity_result.quality
510:         failure_detail = {"reason": detail[:200]}
511: 
512:         def tx(conn: Connection) -> None:
513:             conn.execute(
514:                 _MARK_RETAKE,
515:                 {
516:                     "id": assessment_id,
517:                     "rev": rev,
518:                     "identity_result": _json(identity_result),
519:                     "failure_code": code,
520:                     "failure_detail": _json(failure_detail),
521:                 },
522:             )
523: 
524:         return HandlerResult(business_tx=tx)
525: 
526:     def _terminal(
527:         self,
528:         ctx: HandlerContext,
529:         job: JobRow,
530:         assessment_id: str,
531:         rev: int,
532:         *,
533:         code: str,
534:         message: str,
535:         reason: str,
536:     ) -> None:
537:         _mark_failed(ctx.engine, assessment_id, rev, code, reason)
538:         raise JobFailed(code, message, retryable=False)
539: 
540:     def _transient_or_terminal(
541:         self,
542:         ctx: HandlerContext,
543:         job: JobRow,
544:         assessment_id: str,
545:         rev: int,
546:         *,
547:         code: str,
548:         message: str,
549:         reason: str,
550:     ) -> None:
551:         if job.attempt_count >= job.max_attempts:
552:             _mark_failed(ctx.engine, assessment_id, rev, code, reason)
553:             raise JobFailed(code, message, retryable=False)
554:         raise JobFailed(code, message, retryable=True)

564: def _load_assessment(engine: Engine, assessment_id: str) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
565:     with engine.connect() as conn:
566:         row = conn.execute(_SELECT_ASSESSMENT, {"id": assessment_id}).mappings().first()

570: def _images_for_version(photo_versions: Any, current_photo_version: int) -> Optional[dict[str, str]]:
571:     if not isinstance(photo_versions, dict):
572:         return None
573:     for entry in photo_versions.get("versions", []) or []:
574:         if not isinstance(entry, dict):
575:             continue
576:         if int(entry.get("version", -1)) == current_photo_version:
577:             images = entry.get("images")
578:             if isinstance(images, dict) and all(
579:                 isinstance(images.get(v), str) for v in REQUIRED_VIEWS_ALL
580:             ):
581:                 return {
582:                     "front": images["front"],
583:                     "left": images["left"],
584:                     "right": images["right"],
585:                 }
586:     return None

589: def _validate_metrics(dcfg: DConfig, raw: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
590:     baseline = dcfg.metric_baseline_by_name()
591:     if not baseline:
592:         raise _ContractViolation("$.metrics baseline not configured")
593:     if not isinstance(raw, list) or not raw:
594:         raise _ContractViolation("$.metrics: expected non-empty array")
595:     normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
596:     allowed = {"name", "value", "unit"}
597:     for i, metric in enumerate(raw):
598:         if not isinstance(metric, dict):
599:             raise _ContractViolation(f"$.metrics[{i}]: type violated")
600:         if set(metric) - allowed:

55:     public ParsedA01 parseA01(HttpServletRequest request) {
56:         RawParts raw = split(request);
57:         A01Metadata md = readMetadata(raw.metadataBytes(), A01Metadata.class);
58:         if (!BIGINT.matcher(nullToEmpty(md.photoVersion())).matches() || !"1".equals(md.photoVersion())) {
59:             throw invalid("photoVersion must be the bigint string \"1\" for a new task");
60:         }
61:         requireText(md.captureSessionId(), "captureSessionId", 128);
62:         requireText(md.consentEvidenceRef(), "consentEvidenceRef", 128);
63:         Map<String, byte[]> images = requireExactViews(raw.imageParts(), VIEWS, "front,left,right");
64:         checkTotalSize(images);
65:         return new ParsedA01(md, images);
66:     }

69:         RawParts raw = split(request);
70:         A02Metadata md = readMetadata(raw.metadataBytes(), A02Metadata.class);
71:         if (md.expectedPhotoVersion() == null || !BIGINT.matcher(md.expectedPhotoVersion()).matches()) {
72:             throw invalid("expectedPhotoVersion must be a decimal bigint string");
73:         }
74:         List<String> replaced = md.replacedViews();
75:         if (replaced == null || replaced.isEmpty()) {
76:             throw invalid("replacedViews must be a non-empty list");
77:         }
78:         LinkedHashSet<String> requested = new LinkedHashSet<>();
79:         for (String view : replaced) {
80:             if (!VIEWS.contains(view)) {

82:             }
83:             requested.add(view);
